svg.title: Rajju paper exercise: One cord, two marks, Northeast
svg.desc: Source procedure restored. One source unit is a chosen three millimetres on this paper. The centre line should measure 108 millimetres. The calibration bar should measure 30 millimetres. Print at actual size, 100 percent, without fitting to page. This is a modern activity, not an ancient unit conversion.
svg.text: RAJJU · One cord, two marks · Northeast
Source method restored · 1 chosen paper unit = 3 mm · Thibaut 1875, pp. 9–12
Centre line 36 units = 108 mm on this paper
Fix at E and 36 units inward. Hold at 15; stake at 12.
Unbent cord: 54 units = 162 mm. Measure every mark from the selected end.
Print at actual size (100%). Check the bar before using string. A4 portrait; no fit-to-page.
antonsoo.github.io/rajju/field.html · New drawing MIT · Not an ancient-unit conversion.
